item.title: Advocates, experts warn against vilifying transgender people in wake of Tumbler Ridge shooting
item.description: Advocates and experts are warning about the danger of vilifying an entire demographic based on the actions of one transgender person in the wake of the school shooting in Tumbler Ridge, B.C.

item.title: Deaths in Iran's crackdown on protests reach more than 7,000, activists say
item.description: DUBAI, United Arab Emirates (AP) — The death toll from a crackdown over Iran’s nationwide protests last month has reached at least 7,005 people killed with many more still feared dead, activists said Thursday.
